text: あの　いせきの　とびらには　ふしぎな　もようが　きざまれて　いるんだぜ　…いみは　わかんない　けど

structure.jp: あの　いせきの　とびらには
structure.en: on the door of those ruins

structure.jp: ふしぎな　もようが　きざまれて　いるんだぜ
structure.en: a strange pattern is carved, you know

structure.jp: …いみは　わかんない　けど
structure.en: ...I don't know what it means, though

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The まれ in the verb turns 'carve' into 'be carved': something is done to the pattern by someone not named. きざまれて = 'being carved'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている here shows a lasting result: it was carved and is still there. きざまれて　いる = 'is carved'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and gives the feel of explaining or letting someone in on something. いるんだ = 'it is, you see'.
